purpose: Fresh QA-checked synthetic validation for scoped experimental numeric export; not a stable capability release or publication-image benchmark
layouts: 20/25/30 genes by 6/8/10 samples; labels left/right and above/below; both bar orientations on every side; continuous diverging/sequential/grayscale; 3/5/7 ticks; both numerical directions; grid/no-grid
experimental_scope: Explicit runtime opt-in only: numeric-only, supplied counts and supplied/reviewed linear scale, default detector, all per-image requirements accepted. Inferred counts and OCR scales remain diagnostics/export-review-only.
coverage: Report every ordinary input and unnecessary abstention; 70% remains a product target rather than per-image export permission
evaluation: Four runtime modes decide before truth scoring. Additionally inspect annotated and detected bars conditionally for stroke/text/value/fit diagnostics. No tuning after frozen validation; previous M12 is inspected development regression only.
limitations: Synthetic figures only. Fonts/templates share renderer code between partitions; no unseen-publication/source claim. No real biological matrix or gene database validation. All tick rounding is explicit to 0.01 displayed units.
